notes.text: Hawksbill Gap was the rover's way up the layered rocks of the delta front during the Delta Front Campaign (from sol 415). It tried an abrasion at Hogwallow Flats on sol 471 and worked at Skinner Ridge over sols 477-496.
sources: NASA blog: Next stop, Hawksbill Gap
Williams et al., LPSC 2023: Delta Front Campaign overview
